# hestiacp_ssl (Resource)

Issues a Let's Encrypt SSL certificate for a HestiaCP web domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String)

### Optional

- `aliases` (List of String) Additional SANs to include in the certificate, e.g. `["www.example.com", "mail.example.com"]`.
- `user` (String) HestiaCP username that owns this domain. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
